{{Quote|How well do you really know him?|Fraj T'lin to Leia Organa, about Han Solo|<ref name="Rebel Force: Renegade" />}}
'''Fraj T'lin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arpor-Lan]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Renegade" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] survived an assassination attempt by [[X-7]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] working undercover among the Rebels. X-7 rigged Skywalker's [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] with explosives but the pilot was able to leap to safety at the last minute.<ref name="Rebel Force: Renegade" />

T'lin was tasked by the Alliance to investigate the assassination attempt, and he sent modified [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droids]] programmed to detect traces of [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]]. One of the droids found two [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of detonite in the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] temporary quarters in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]]. T'lin confronted Solo about the evidence, and when the smuggler denied any wrongdoing, the lieutenant took him to custody. T'lin then reported his findings to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Renegade" />
